ctx.x: Oh, my goodness, man. He was worse than the rest of them because he was refined. See, a gentleman thug is worse than -- a conscious thug; he's refined. See, he's refined but he knows how to do that act better than the other one does because he knows what to do to you and where to hit you at. That isn't an element, but he knows what to do to you. Boom! (Inaudible) and you're knocked out. (Inaudible).
